test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth letter-number cluster in the same way as the first letter-number cluster is related to the second letter-number cluster and fifth letter-number cluster is related to sixth letter-number cluster.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

KIH13 : GED169 :: ? : FSU196 :: RTX17 : NPT289
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/666416b0dcf4fdb4cffa0d66a12b555d07e54367b2b2e8bd4f0ab982e35d88a2.png] 

Logic followed here is:

**Letters:** Each letter in the first cluster is shifted back by 4 positions in the second cluster.

**Numbers:** The number in the first cluster is squared to get the number in the second cluster.

**For KIH13 : GED169 →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58ece9b620a05cef57275be35640aa245fe011218331e3fbfacd6307f36c94fe.png] 

**For RTX17 : NPT289 →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/708a2ce2064d66729b02c7a4a07a88d3c75f3512443874fa1c0841276c276480.png] 

**Similarly, for ? : FSU196 →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9b14530a63597bc503562072908a7811fcbe2415bfe08bfb3579b8a3ffe3e74.png] 

 

Therefore, the missing cluster is **JWY14**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
